title: MBBQ: A Dataset for Cross-Lingual Comparison of Stereotypes in Generative LLMs
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark for evaluating social stereotypes in LLMs. While it includes categories like gender, age, and disability, it explicitly excludes the 'religion' category from the source BBQ dataset, stating that stereotypes in that category are too culturally dependent for the cross-lingual comparison focus of this work.
